prompt: Write the note left under a windshield wiper after backing into a truck in the church parking lot. It must fully accept responsibility, contain a working phone number format, quote Scripture appropriately, and still somehow preserve your dignity. Four constraints. All of them.
response:
*You find this note secured under your wiper blade, written on the back of a church bulletin.*

---

I am so sorry. I misjudged the distance and I am the one who dented your passenger-side door. There is no excuse. I was distracted, I was wrong, and this was entirely my fault.

Please call me so I can make this right. My number is (555) 272-1984.

“Whoever conceals their sins does not prosper, but the one who confesses and renounces them finds mercy.” — Proverbs 28:13

I am not above this moment, only humbled by it. I will answer when you call.

— A repentant parishioner
